page_title: INT 1-0 GEN | Inter v Genoa 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Marco Piccinini is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' The yellow card goes to Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).

90+4' The opposition back off Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Nicola Leali denies him with the save.
90+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Lautaro Martinez (Inter) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Nicola Leali was forced into action to thwart Mehdi Taremi (Inter). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
88' Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
85' The substitution has been made. Matteo Darmian (Inter) has replaced Federico Dimarco.
83' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
82' Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) takes a shot which is well saved by the goalkeeper.
80' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Bastoni will be replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
80' Here comes a substitution. Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Patrizio Masini.

78' 1 - 0 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 1:0.
78' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take a corner kick.
77' Junior Messias (Genoa) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
76' The corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is intercepted by the defence.

76' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) jumps high inside the box to head the rebound towards the left side of the goal, but Josep Martinez pulls off an amazing reflex save to keep the ball out of the net. Nice goalkeeping skill! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.
72' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
72' Substitution. Jean Onana (Genoa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fabio Miretti walks off.
70' Nicolo Barella (Inter) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
69' Junior Messias (Genoa) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
68' Inter are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
66' Substitution. Andrea Pinamonti makes his way off the pitch and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes on as his replacement.
66' The game has come to an end for Jeff Ekhator. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Junior Messias (Genoa).
66' The substitution is prepared. Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alessandro Zanoli.
65' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Piotr Zielinski (Inter) replacing Henrikh Mkhitaryan.

65' Nicola Leali makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Benjamin Pavard (Inter) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
65' Today's match ends for Kristjan Asllani who will be replaced by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
64' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner with a short pass.
64' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
62' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
60' Nicolo Barella (Inter) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Nicola Leali.
59' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
56' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Fabio Miretti (Genoa) for his blatant foul.

55' A dangerous towering header by Mattia Bani (Genoa) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
55' The referee awards a corner and Fabio Miretti (Genoa) goes over to take it.
54' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Genoa have a corner.
53' Wonderful movement by Genoa. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
51' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Inter will take a throw-in.

49' Inter slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
47' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' Simone Inzaghi makes a half-time substitution. Mehdi Taremi (Inter) comes on in place of Joaquin Correa.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' The game is interrupted now, Joaquin Correa (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

41' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Inter are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
38' Federico Dimarco (Inter) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
36' Federico Dimarco (Inter) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
36' Joaquin Correa (Inter) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. Inter win a corner.
35' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kristjan Asllani (Inter). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
33' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
33' Aaron Martin (Genoa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Genoa.
33' Josep Martinez (Inter) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
31' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
30' The linesman raises his flag. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is adjudged offside.
28' Federico Dimarco (Inter) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
28' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Inter earn a corner.
26' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
25' Genoa are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but it's cleared.
21' Federico Dimarco (Inter) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Inter get a corner.
20' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' Aaron Martin (Genoa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a throw-in.
16' The referee blows his whistle after Patrizio Masini (Genoa) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
14' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
12' That's unlucky! Fabio Miretti (Genoa) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
11' Genoa showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
9' The ball is cleared after Denzel Dumfries (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

4' Nicola Leali makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of inside the right post.
3' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. It's a throw-in for Inter.
2' Inter are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is behind the touchline and Inter will take a throw-in.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Marco Piccinini is introduced as the referee for today's match.
